mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Jayce and his allies' Ultimate Abilities cast an additional Static Field around themselves.

“There's always a way to save ourselves.”

Viktor's evolution was challenged by Jayce, leaving Viktor's efforts incomplete.

The future slipped from my grasp... Yet I remain. This is not the end—only a delay.

mBuff.mDescription:
Mercury Hammer
Jayce is wielding his Mercury Hammer and is melee.Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Jayce must take down Viktor 5 times.
Jayce must take down Viktor 5 times.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Acceleration Gate</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has greatly increased Move Speed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it.
If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mercury Cannon</keywordMajor>: Jayce deploys an acceleration gate for @spell.JayceAccelerationGate:Duration@ seconds that grants <speed>@spell.JayceAccelerationGate:MovementSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @spell.JayceAccelerationGate:HasteDuration@ seconds to allied champions that pass through it.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Hyper Charge</titleLeft><mainText>Jayce's has greatly increased Attack Speed for his next several attacks.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Gains a burst of energy increasing Attack Speed to maximum for several attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mercury Cannon:</keywordMajor> Jayce overcharges his cannon, gaining maximum <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> for his next @spell.JayceHyperCharge:NumAttacks@ Attacks. These Attacks deal <physicalDamage>@spell.JayceHyperCharge:ActualDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: When Jayce swaps weapons he gains Move Speed for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Jayce can swap between melee and ranged weapons using <spellName>Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer</spellName> starting from level 1. Swapping weapons also swaps all his Abilities and grants him <speed>@FlatMovementSpeed@ Move Speed</speed> for @MovementSpeedDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Mercury Hammer: Charged</titleLeft><mainText>Jayce's next strike deals additional magic damage.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Mercury Cannon: Charged</titleLeft><mainText>Jayce's next strike reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Mercury Cannon</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has reduced Armor and Magic Resist.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies in the area of the explosion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mercury Cannon</keywordMajor>: Jayce fires an orb of electricity, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.JayceShockBlast:Damage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to the first enemy hit and all surrounding enemies. Firing this orb through <spellName>{{Spell_JayceAccelerationGate_Name}}</spellName> increases the range, speed and raises the damage to <physicalDamage>@spell.JayceShockBlast:EmpoweredDamage@</physicalDamage>.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Mercury Cannon</titleLeft><mainText>Jayce is wielding the Mercury Cannon and is ranged.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Mercury Hammer</titleLeft><mainText>Jayce is wielding the Mercury Hammer and is melee.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mercury Cannon:</keywordMajor> Jayce transforms his weapon into the <keywordMajor>Mercury Hammer</keywordMajor>, becoming melee ranged and gaining new Abilities and <scaleArmor>@spell.JayceStanceHtG:Resists@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>. Jayce's next Attack deals an additional <magicDamage>@spell.JayceStanceHtG:Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Hammer Stance: Transforms the Mercury Hammer into the Mercury Cannon gaining new abilities and increased range. The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.

Cannon Stance: Transforms the Mercury Cannon into the Mercury Hammer gaining new abilities and increasing Armor and Magic Resist. The first attack in this form deals additional magic damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mercury Hammer</keywordMajor>: Jayce transforms his weapon into the <keywordMajor>Mercury Cannon</keywordMajor>, gaining Attack Range and new Abilities. Jayce's next Attack removes <scaleArmor>@spell.JayceStanceHtG:RangedFormShred@ Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for @spell.JayceStanceHtG:ShredDuration@ seconds.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Lightning Field</titleLeft><mainText>Jayce is dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Hammer Stance: Passive: Restores Mana per strike. Active: Creates a field of lightning damaging nearby enemies for several seconds.

Cannon Stance: Gains a burst of energy, increasing Attack Speed to maximum for several attacks.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Mercury Hammer - Passive: Jayce's Hammer Attacks grant @spell.JayceStaticField:ManaGain@ Mana.

Mercury Hammer - Active: Jayce creates an electric aura dealing @spell.JayceStaticField:Damage@ magic damage over @spell.JayceStaticField:Duration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Hammer Stance: Deals magic damage to an enemy and knocks them back a short distance.

Cannon Stance: Deploys an Acceleration Gate increasing the Move Speed of all allied champions who pass through it. If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Hammer Form</keywordMajor>: Jayce swings his hammer, <status>Knocking Back</status> his target and dealing <magicDamage>@spell.JayceThunderingBlow:FlatDamage@ plus @spell.JayceThunderingBlow:PercHPDamage*100@% max Health magic damage</magicDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules><keywordMajor>Hammer</keywordMajor> swing does a max of <magicDamage>@MonsterCap@ magic damage</magicDamage> against jungle monsters.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Hammer Stance: Leaps to an enemy dealing physical damage and slowing enemies.

Cannon Stance: Fires an orb of electricity that detonates upon hitting an enemy (or reaching the end of its path) dealing physical damage to all enemies hit.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <keywordMajor>Mercury Hammer:</keywordMajor> Jayce leaps to an enemy, dealing <physicalDamage>@spell.JayceToTheSkies:Damage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to surrounding enemies and <status>Slowing</status> them by @spell.JayceToTheSkies:Slow*-100@% for @spell.JayceToTheSkies:SlowDuration@ seconds.
